name: orchestration
description: Orchestration for Claude Code, planning included: super-plan turns a feature into wave-ready tasks with machine-checkable contracts (validated by a shipped plan linter), and multi-model executes them as supervised waves — isolated executors judged against their contracts by a different model, with the escalation ladder shipped as tested code. Routes tasks to Haiku 4.5 / Sonnet 5 / Opus 5 / Opus 4.8 / Fable 5.1, picks reasoning effort, adapts to whichever model orchestrates. Grounded in Anthropic system cards.
